Description:
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Features[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]The interior of the re-conceptured farmhouse[/*]
[*]The room arrangement is more reasonable[/*]
[*]There are two attics and 4 styles[/*]
[*]Removable kitchen[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Recoloring should be compatible, as original game assets are used[/*]
[*]Compatible with customised spouse room[/*]
[*][b][color=#cc0000]Incompatible[/color][/b] with multiple love[/*]
[/list]
[b][color=#e69138][size=4]Bug[/size][/color][/b]
[list]

[list]
[*]Please empty all furniture every time you upgrade.[/*]

This is my first time making a mod, Please forgive me for any shortcomings. The English text was also translated by AI, and I apologize for any confusing parts.
